title: Weak-lensing mass calibration of Planck Sunyaev-Zel'dovich clusters with HSC-SSP Year 3
efc_relevance: Stacked HSC-SSP-Y3 weak-lensing calibration of 19 Planck SZ clusters with explicit log-mass-bias, miscentering and SZ-scatter forward modelling over 0.5-5.0 h^-1 Mpc. Provides an independent cluster-cosmology mass anchor that bears on the eROSITA-vs-SPT-3G cluster-S8 split flagged in pending_review_2026_05_01 cluster_cosmology_split.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as Planck-SZ × HSC-SSP cluster anchor; promote pending_review_2026_05_01 cluster_cosmology_split cluster; cross-reference framework:LCDM-Planck2018 and the eROSITA/SPT-3G cluster-cosmology pending entries.
